---
id: env.obl.clean-up-consent
type: obligation
heading: Clean-up Consent
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

Except for emergency response costs, you must not incur clean-up costs without our written consent, which we will not unreasonably withhold or delay. We may appoint, or approve, the consultants and contractors who carry out the clean-up, and you must give them reasonable access.
